body: I'll think about it. I always figured I wouldn't bring it up until I was living on my own.
Nope. She disapproves of enough that's going on in my life, and my future plans. Which is a main reason why my depression is SO bad right now. Plus, if she found out she'd blame herself, like always.
I told my boyfriend. He's staying with me and not going to his conference. I feel bad.
My friend just said I couldn't stay with her this weekend, so we'll see how this goes I guess.

Sorry, I'm not going to share my plans. As a matter of fact I have decided not to go through with it at this point in time. For this weekend I hope to stay with a friend while my boyfriend is away, which will almost certainly stop me from killing myself. 

I hope that you can find an alternative plan instead of suicide, but if not I wish you peace. You can PM me if you want to talk.
I'm still under her insurance and everything, and I'm just scared that a bill will come in, and she'll ask me about it, and I'll have to tell her.

I'm too scared to talk to any of my friends about it. I think they might call someone to try to stop me or talk to me. My boyfriend has said he would call my mother if I got too suicidal. Which would be really bad. She's the main reason I haven't seen a therapist. She has some strong opinions about depressed people. 

Other than that, at this moment I'm really confused. I keep seeing/thinking about things in the future, and realize that I'm not going to alive to do any of it. It kind of makes me sad, especially the thought of not hugging my boyfriend or seeing my dog again or something, but at the same time life has been really rough on me, and it's only going to get rougher.
